<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N – H – X) / 2. For the molecular formula C₁₁H₂O₄Cl, C = 11, H = 2, N = 0, X (halogens) = 1. Plugging in: DBE = (2·11 + 2 – 2 – 1) / 2 = (24 – 3) / 2 = 21 / 2 = 10.5. Since DBE must be an integer for a chemically valid formula, the nearest whole number is 10.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
